The HWPX document automation task achieved full success by correctly implementing the training feedback logic and passing the legacy pytest suite.
The execution resulted in a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.83, with zero errors reported across all trials. The pytest tool confirmed that 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed successfully in 0.13 seconds. While the current implementation is robust, future iterations should re-check edge cases in HWPX XML parsing that might not be fully covered by the single legacy test case.
